text:
nina_fin: FYI ArgusWave (acct AW-7721) has 3 invoices outstanding = $62,450. Oldest is ~58 days past due. Collections vendor says client claims account locked after a chargeback and wants to push ACH from a different bank. Theyre disputing a usage line of $3,150 on invoice INV-20240710 and asking for a one-time credit + portal unlock to pay. @maria_support @oscar_sales can we triage?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240615 ($28,450), INV-20240520 ($20,000), INV-20240710 ($14,000). Total outstanding: $62,450. Last recorded payment: none in 2024. Collections vendor: Brightline Collections, outreach started 2024-08-18.

derek_collections: They've been evasive on calls. Client mentioned "legal team" if we escalate. I recommend short hold if finance wants to negotiate, but need a firm timeline otherwise we resume standard dunning.

maria_support: I can allow a temporary portal unlock for 30 minutes once we have bank docs + signed reclaim ack. Workflow: open ticket, run fraud checks, then run `/temporary-unlock --acct=AW-7721 --minutes=30 --by=maria_support`. Use secure intake: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload (no channel DMs).

ioscar_sales: Proposal from my side: offer a 5% settlement on the total unpaid if they pay 100% within 7 days, or a 40/30/30 split over 3 months with a signed schedule. Use settlement only to avoid legal noise. I'll take point on client comms if finance OKs.

nina_fin: Policy note: operations can provisionally credit up to $1,500 without CFO sign-off; anything above requires CFO approval and accounting reserve entry MR-AR-ADJ. Also we mark disputed amount in GL until reconciliation.

arthur_cfo: Quick call: approve provisional credit of $3,150 for the disputed usage line, conditional steps: 1) Client uploads bank letter + voided check OR completes micro-deposit verification in 30m window. 2) Client signs our 14-day reconciliation & payment commitment form (we'll route to legal). 3) Sales submits payment plan or settlement acceptance via email to finance. Collections: pause further third-party outreach until 2024-08-25 COB. Add account note: "PROV_CREDIT_3150_arthur_2024-08-19".

maria_support: Copy. I'll create ticket SB-91802, request docs, run KYC, and standby for unlock command once docs verified. Will attach fraud-check logs to the ticket.

ioscar_sales: I'll send settlement + commitment email now, CC collections & finance. If they accept 5% settlement, we'll put payment link in the email and ask them to pay during the unlock window.

derek_collections: Pausing outreach until 2024-08-25. If no signed ack and payment by then, we'll resume escalation on 2024-08-26.

nina_fin: I'll prepare the provisional credit GL entry and put a hold on credits until we get the signed form. Accounting will tag AR reserve code MR-AR-ADJ and note the CFO approval.

ioscar_sales: client asked about a "chargeback" showing on their bank. I'll ask them to get chargeback ref and merchant bank contact info as part of KYC.

arthur_cfo: One more: no rolling payment plans without C-level approval on accounts >$50k. This one gets case-by-case approval because of the legal mention. Keep me in the loop on SB-91802.

nina_fin: Thanks everyone 10: I'll update the AR ticket and mark collections hold. Will post final status here after SB-91802 is updated.

maria_support: SB-91802 created. Standing by for docs and will run `/temporary-unlock` after verification.

ioscar_sales: Reached out to client. They said they'd upload documents within the hour. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
